cards.title: EDITING CONTRACT
cards.text: 1080×1920 · 30fps · one continuous presenter. No product substitutions. Keep both handles, inward-falling strap tails and oval closure intact. No simulated interior or capacity demonstrations. Caption groups follow actual VO; final timing must be aligned before export.

cards.title: OFFER
cards.text: $149.99. Pre-order; shipping expected October. Keep this condition legible throughout offer and CTA. Recheck live offer before publication.
